_note: The hub layer. The Local Government Fiscal Framework Act indexes municipal capital funding to provincial revenue from three years prior — a statutory link running straight from Alberta's fiscal position to every municipality's road-repair budget. This slice also closes the detached education pair by connecting the K-12 funding manual to the budget that sets its grant rates.

reports.title: Alberta Budget — Fiscal Plan
reports.description: The centrepiece of Alberta's annual budget, setting out revenue, expense and the fiscal position across a three-year horizon. Contains the economic outlook, capital plan and tax plan chapters, and is the source of the provincial revenue figures that statutory funding formulas key off.
reports.cadence_note: Tabled in late February for the fiscal year beginning 1 April.

release_schedule.note: Alberta has tabled its fiscal plan in the last week of February in every recent year (27 February 2020, 28 February 2023, 27 February 2024). The Fiscal Planning and Transparency Act is believed to set a statutory deadline of 28 February, but no citation for that provision has been read yet, so this stays observed rather than stated-rule and the whole month is claimed rather than a day. Tighten to 'stated-rule' with a day once the section is quoted.

reports.title: Fiscal Update and Economic Statement
reports.description: In-year revision of Alberta's revenue, expense and deficit forecasts against the tabled budget. The vehicle by which future municipal funding envelopes are communicated in advance.
reports.cadence_note: Three per year — on or before the last day of August, November and February. A Final Results year-end report follows by the end of June.

reports.title: Alberta Economic Outlook
reports.description: The province's forecast for growth, employment, inflation, population and energy prices. Published as a chapter of the fiscal plan; the assumptions underneath every provincial revenue projection.

dependencies.basis: The LGFF Act sets a Revenue Index Factor comparing provincial revenue three years prior against four years prior, and municipal capital funding rises or falls by exactly that percentage. 2025 funding rose 13.6% to $820 million on the strength of 13.6% revenue growth between 2021-22 and 2022-23.
Aggregate LGFF funding amounts must be communicated to municipalities two years in advance, and are announced through the quarterly fiscal update.
The economic outlook is a chapter of the fiscal plan and supplies the growth, employment, inflation and energy price assumptions from which every revenue line is forecast.
Each quarterly update revises the revenue, expense and deficit forecasts set out in the tabled fiscal plan, and is reported against it.

reference_period.stated_as: 'Each quarterly update revises the revenue, expense and deficit forecasts set out in the tabled fiscal plan' — three updates a year despite the name.

dependencies.basis: Grant rates in the Funding Manual for School Authorities are set by the K-12 education allocation voted in the provincial budget; the manual distributes the envelope the fiscal plan establishes.
